notes: Franck's original output for violin is very small: the Sonata, the two early duos (Op. 6 and Op. 14, already queued) and the short posthumous Mélancolie. No transcription of his music, including the many Panis angelicus versions, has a single established violinist-arranger I can name with certainty, so none are included.
